C0475.title: Fans Steal Air Miles from Actor Wu Lei and Other Celebrities
C0475.summary: In September 2020, a fan of actor Wu Lei was exposed for binding the star's airline membership account since 2017, adding themselves and friends as authorized users, and redeeming 230,000 miles for flight tickets.
